*Here is a summary and confirmation of your pitch:*

Dear Authority Magazine Editors,

Please kindly consider me or my client for the following interview topic:

Name and Title of The Interviewee Blakely Page
Name and Company of The Publicist Submitting (If applicable) Tiffany
Crockett, Go Fish Digital
Has this interviewee been featured in Authority Magazine before? No
What is the name of the interview topic you are pitching for? (Choose one
please) Five Things You Need To Be A Highly Effective Leader
Your 200 word pitch Blakely Page would be an excellent guest for Authority
Magazine’s interview series featuring individuals and organizations
creating important social impact. He is a Principal at JM Search and a
respected financial-industry leader with experience in capital management,
organizational growth, and strategic leadership. His perspective is
compelling because he pairs professional achievement with sustained,
hands-on community commitment. Blakely has contributed to educational
institutions, character-based scholarships, and veteran-support
initiatives. His work has helped expand access to opportunity for students
while supporting programs that recognize character, perseverance, and
leadership. He also helped establish a gym for Merging Veterans and Players
in New York City, providing veterans with a community-centered space
focused on connection, wellness, and support. His recognition through the
HeartShare Humanitarian Award and the PAM Rising Star distinction reflects
a record of leadership defined by integrity and service. In this interview,
Blakely can share how business leaders can use their resources,
relationships, and professional expertise to serve communities with
purpose. He can speak to selecting causes that align with personal values,
building durable philanthropic initiatives, supporting veterans and young
people, and measuring success through organizational growth and meaningful
human impact. His story offers readers a practical example of values-driven
leadership in action.
What is the occupation of the interviewee? Entrepreneur
What is the business website of the interviewee?
https://www.blakelypage.org/
Links to The Interviewee's Best Social Media Profiles
https://www.linkedin.com/in/blakelypage
A High Quality Image of the Interviewee File 1
<https://drive.google.com/open?id=1ui9nJDGMWvMU-6VE7zWGo1Ca_1ThKc3c>

Name and Title of The Interviewee Manu J. Nair, Co-founder & CEO, Ethereal

Reusable Medium-Lift Launch Vehicle
Your 200 word pitch Manu J. Nair is the Co-founder and CEO of Ethereal
Exploration Guild (The Guild), a Bengaluru-based space technology company
building Razor Crest Mk-1, the world’s first fully reusable medium-lift
launch vehicle. Designed around a reusable upper stage, Razor Crest Mk-1
aims to recover and reuse both stages of the rocket — tackling one of the
biggest challenges in space transportation today. Manu’s journey offers a
compelling perspective on what it takes to build an ambitious,
capital-intensive deep-tech company from India for a global market. He can
speak about building breakthrough aerospace technology from the ground up,
navigating risk and failure, assembling highly specialised teams, and
maintaining a long-term vision in an industry where development cycles are
measured in years rather than months. Beyond The Guild’s technology, Manu
can offer a broader perspective on why the global launch market needs to
move from concentrated capacity towards a more multipolar future, how full
reusability could fundamentally change the economics of access to orbit,
and why India has the opportunity to become a major global hub for frontier
technology. His experience combines entrepreneurship, engineering ambition
and a mission to make access to space more affordable and flexible.

*Here is a summary and confirmation of your pitch:*

Dear Authority Magazine Editors,

Please kindly consider me or my client for the following interview topic:

Name and Title of The Interviewee Shannon Nutter and Julia Carreon
Name and Company of The Publicist Submitting (If applicable) Sarah Hodgen -
Practical Inspiration Publishing
Has this interviewee been featured in Authority Magazine before? No
What is the name of the interview topic you are pitching for? (Choose one
please) Women of the C-Suite
Your 200 word pitch Shannon Nutter and Julia Carreon have decades of
expertise in leadership, strategy and large-scale transformation, they have
now joined forces to share hard-won tips for identifying, preparing for and
countering workplace land mines. Their mission: mobilize women to build
collective power and change the broken systems in which they work.
Examining the “glass cliff”, their takedown playbook and persistent
institutional bias, Walking on Broken Glass offers a practical,
experience-led guide to recognising and responding to the systems that
undermine women at work. Drawing on their own C-suite careers in global
financial institutions, Shannon and Julia call on women to claim their
power, act collectively and build careers that are successful on their own
terms. The result is a timely and urgent call to action for women, leaders
and organizations ready to move beyond performative progress and towards
lasting change. As such they would be excellent Women in C-Suite
interviewees.
What is the occupation of the interviewee? Shannon Nutter is a global
executive and board director and Julia C. Carreon is a financial services
executive.
What is the business website of the interviewee?
https://walkingonbrokenglass.com/
Links to The Interviewee's Best Social Media Profiles
https://www.linkedin.com/in/shannon-nutter/;
https://www.linkedin.com/in/julia-c-carreon-8318674/
A High Quality Image of the Interviewee File 1
<https://drive.google.com/open?id=1cij-HvD2dmf9mU9r7DoxlRgUBw9DQILr>
In which country does the interviewee live? USA
What is the best email to follow up with you? sarah@practicalinspiration.com
